Lemma
[uniform short-time existence over a compact set]

Source: petersen:page-0190 ↗ thm:pet-ch5-local-existence

If $\tilde K\subset TM$ is compact, there is $\varepsilon >0$ such that for each $(q,v)\in \tilde K$ there is a geodesic $c:(-\varepsilon ,\varepsilon )\to M$ with $c(0)=q$, $\dot c(0)=v$.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch5-local-existence \sketch Local existence gives each $(q,v)\in \tilde K$ a neighborhood in $TM$ and a positive existence time. A finite subcover of compact $\tilde K$ and the minimum of the corresponding times provide one $\varepsilon >0$ for all data.

□
